@shivam_kushwaha16Thanks Shivam, we actually take a checkpoint before every fix and verify the change right after. If verification fails, Backenly rolls back to that checkpoint automatically, but only if no rows written after the fix would be affected. If some would, the rollback waits for your approval and shows you exactly what it would change. You can also roll back any change yourself from History.
